ACUVUE · MyACUVUE ® Focal brand, read against Alcon, Bausch & Lomb, CooperVision and Olens Registration goal 7% → 14%

Bottom line Acuvue is level with peers on sentiment, so the barrier is not the brand. It is the MyACUVUE app: 94% of reviews negative in 2024-2026 (n=33). 1 · Position Acuvue is level with peers on sentiment +38 vs +44 Net sentiment, Acuvue vs peers Interval -15 to +5 2 · Barrier Product & look draws the most complaints, level with peers 28 complaints Acuvue items negative or mixed on Product & look 3 · App reviews The app loses people at sign-in, registration and points 94% negative Written app reviews that are negative, 2024-2026 n=33 4 · Demand Search interest and lens imports point in opposite directions +56% searches Change in Acuvue search interest vs 2025 Lens imports -25% in units, 2023 to 2025 Implication. Lead WhatsApp with sign-in, OTP and date-of-birth help at Trial, then comfort proof and first-fitting guidance. Size registration drop-off with Stage 2 data before setting the 7% to 14% path.
Evidence Fact How sure we are of each finding Fact = counted. Directional = small or skewed sample. Level, B, A = strength of a brand gap.

Acuvue sentiment is level with peers 245 vs 690 items; 7 channels Brand & market > Position Level Acuvue trails on KiasuParents (-48) 17 vs 24 items; peers are 38% Alcon Brand & market > Channels B · one channel Acuvue trails on YouTube (-36) 65 vs 212 items; peers are 97% Olens Brand & market > Channels B · one channel Acuvue leads on Xiaohongshu comments (+31) 22 vs 39 items; peers are 44% Olens Brand & market > Channels B · one channel Acuvue draws more Guidance & service complaints than peers 16 vs 21 complaints; YouTube only Barriers & journey > Barrier B · one channel Product & look is the main topic 103 Acuvue items; level vs peers Brand & market > Themes Directional The app is the clearest barrier (94% negative, 2024-2026) 119 written reviews; Acuvue only, skews negative Barriers & journey > App Market fact Store reviews are positive and about the shop 862 contact-lens reviews; skews positive Barriers & journey > Retail Directional Search interest is up while imports are down Google Trends index, 261 weeks; imports 2023 to 2025 Brand & market > Demand Directional Registration drop-off and the 7% to 14% path No registration or CRM data in scraped sources Category users & hypotheses > Stage 2 bridge Needs internal data
Supporting facts Shown only where n≥15. None of it measures registration.
Market fact counted directly Directional patterns, not prevalence
n=33 reviews Directional 94% of 2024-2026 written app reviews are negative The app is poorly rated; complaints are sign-in, launch, points and messages

- **Apple App Store:** 2.36 stars (70 ratings, 51% 1-star) - **Google Play:** 3.32 stars (1,099 ratings, 32% 1-star) - **2017-2019:** 54% of 54 written reviews negative - **2020-2023:** 59% of 32 written reviews negative - **2024-2026:** 94% of 33 written reviews negative - **App utility & support:** 23 of 79 negative reviews - **Registration / login friction:** 16 of 79 negative reviews - **Unwanted messaging / privacy:** 10 of 79 negative reviews - **Broke after an update:** 13 of 77 one- and two-star reviews
n=862 store reviews Directional 9 vs 76 loyalty and app topics: store reviews vs app complaints The retailer link is an app complaint, not a store complaint

- **Store reviews:** loyalty or app topics in 9 of 862 contact-lens reviews - **App reviews:** 76 complaint items on loyalty, points, registration or the app, of 119 - **Store reviews are about the shop:** only 12 of 862 name Acuvue
Google Trends index Directional +56% Acuvue search interest vs 2025 Search interest and imports point opposite ways

- **Acuvue search interest:** +56% vs 2025 (Jan to 20 Sep) - **Share of category searches:** 25% to 32% - **Category search interest:** +22% - **Lens imports (units):** -25%, 2023 to 2025; Singapore also re-exports
UN Comtrade Market fact -25% lens imports in units, 2023 to 2025 Lens imports fell about 25% in 2023-25: the category is likely shrinking

- **Units:** imports of HS 9001.30 -25%, 2023 to 2025 - **Value:** -23%, unit price +2%: the move is in volume, not price - **Caveat:** imports are a proxy for demand (Singapore also re-exports); trade data is the only source, SingStat has nothing at this product level
n=40 listings Market fact 40 lens listings offered online, 7 of them ACUVUE Lenses are offered for direct online sale, illegal under the HSA

- **40** distinct lens listings flagged, **7** of them ACUVUE (18%): mostly a category-wide problem, not only ours - Shows an offer, not a completed sale or genuine stock - Lens solution (for example RevitaLens) is outside the rule and is compared on price separately
Next steps Fact Five hypotheses need Stage 2 data that scraping cannot supply What the data shows, and what would test each.

Hypothesis Sign-up and launch problems in the MyACUVUE app put people off registering What the scraped data shows App-store reviews (written reviews skew negative: types of friction, not prevalence) Stage 2 data that would test it Registration funnel drop-off by step; OTP delivery logs Hypothesis The retailer or loyalty link adds friction What the scraped data shows Mostly an app-side complaint in reviews; little on Google Maps Stage 2 data that would test it ECP notes, retailer incentives, reorder timing Hypothesis Messaging that mentions the app or points would lift registration What the scraped data shows Too few posts mention it to test Stage 2 data that would test it Registration by campaign / WhatsApp message; A/B test Hypothesis Grey-market listings undermine the brand What the scraped data shows Listings are countable; sales and stock are not Stage 2 data that would test it J&J authorised-seller list; sell-through data Hypothesis We are on track for 7% to 14% What the scraped data shows Not possible from EBI Stage 2 data that would test it Registration records, CRM, locked 'eligible trial consumer' definition

Bottom line Acuvue is level with peers on net sentiment (+38 vs +44; gap -5); by channel it is behind on KiasuParents (-48) and YouTube (-36), ahead on Xiaohongshu comments (+31). 1 · Position Acuvue is level with peers on sentiment +38 vs +44 Net sentiment, Acuvue vs peers Same read at one channel mix 2 · Channels Acuvue is behind on KiasuParents (-48) and YouTube (-36), ahead on Xiaohongshu comments (+31) 3 of 7 differ Channels with 15+ items per side where Acuvue differs from peers 3 · Themes Product & look is what people talk about most 3 of 4 groups Topic groups with enough items to compare 42% of Acuvue items; net +50 vs +65, level with peers 4 · Brand voice Acuvue's own posts are mostly promotion; consumers talk about product and look 92% promo Share of Acuvue's own posts that are promotion Consumers raise product and look in 42% of items 5 · Demand Search interest and lens imports point in opposite directions +56% searches Change in Acuvue search interest vs 2025 Lens imports -25% in units, 2023 to 2025 Implication. Sentiment is level, so the registration gap is not a brand problem. Lead with proof on product and look, where people talk most. Treat demand as unsettled until internal sales data settles imports vs searches.
